decisions.reason: The product is close to the firm's established offer and builds on existing web hosting and online shop knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
The responsive website template is close to the firm's established website and CMS expertise, enabling learning and adaptation.
Premium customer support is close to the firm's existing service operations and technical know-how, so the firm can assimilate feedback and refine it.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's established software and tool development, and in-house R&D supports learning and improvement.

The online tool for creating data processing contracts lies far from the firm's established technical and hosting knowledge, making it hard to interpret early results and improve despite in-house R&D.
